t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Remembering which color of gnome leads to one of two forests is key to earning mushroom collecting points. With this objective in mind, it behooves one to determine which of the two forest consistently bears more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The goal is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. You will see sets of gnomes, 2 of a different color each time, the color of the gnomes within the sets stays consistent although their positions may change. Each gnome leads to one of two forests, one with a red basket and another with a yellow basket. Certain colored gnomes consistently reach same basket. The challenge is to determine which forest has more mushrooms available for harvest.
